What conditions does Dr. Rajesh Reddy treat? Dr. Rajesh Reddy Sannareddy treats a wide range of brain and spine conditions, including brain tumors, herniated and degenerated discs, spinal stenosis, brain aneurysms and vascular malformations, chronic back and neck pain, and traumatic brain and spine injuries. Treatment plans range from conservative management to advanced microsurgical and endoscopic procedures, depending on the diagnosis. How do I prepare for a neurosurgical consultation? Bring any previous MRI, CT scans, or medical reports related to your condition, along with a list of current medications and past surgeries. It helps to write down your symptoms, when they started, and any questions you want answered — this ensures the consultation covers everything that matters to you. What is minimally invasive brain & spine surgery? Minimally invasive neurosurgery uses smaller incisions, specialized instruments, and real-time imaging or endoscopic visualization to treat brain and spine conditions with less disruption to surrounding tissue. Compared to traditional open surgery, patients typically experience less pain, shorter hospital stays, and faster return to daily activities. How long is the recovery period after surgery? Recovery time depends on the type and complexity of the procedure. Minimally invasive spine surgeries often allow patients to walk within a day and resume light activity in 2–4 weeks, while more complex brain surgeries may require a longer, closely monitored recovery. Dr. Rajesh Reddy provides a personalized recovery timeline and rehabilitation plan for every patient. All that we do is identify and schedule a site visit of a potential buyer Education We create visibility online for the students of various specialties and drive footfalls to institutions through our inbound marketing strategies People also ask What is Inbound Marketing? Inbound marketing drives customers to our platforms (website, social profiles, youtube channels, Google My Business, etc.,) by creating valuable content and experiences tailored to our target audience with an objective of initiating an interaction or offering a solution to their problem or requirement What is the significance of Inside sales? Inbound sales is responding to the enquiries generated from marketing activities, thus they are sales qualified leads with higher probability of conversions. In Inbound sales, the prospect expresses interest and initiates the sales process. The sales people acts as a consultant, addressing the prospects pain points, aligning the sales process to the buyer��s journey. Why should I outsource customer care? With the rapid digital transformation of businesses online post COVID, start-ups and mid-sized businesses can quickly scale up their operations outsourcing the functions of customer care as quick response rates to the customer interactions on webchats, social media, e-mail and support contact numbers helps in better customer experiences and conversions. What are the benefits of deploying marketing and sales tools? The marketing RoI can be maximized with an effective automation of leads flowing in from multiple marketing platforms, which helps in lead scoring, thus segmenting the sales qualified leads for the sales consultant to attend or follow-up for the sales closures. This rapidly increases the sales volume of each consultant. With automation of sales funnel, we also can analyse the RoI of various marketing channels. Inbound marketing drives customers to our platforms (website, social profiles, youtube channels, Google My Business, etc.,) by creating valuable content and experiences tailored to our target audience with an objective of initiating an interaction or offering a solution to their problem or requirement What is the significance of Inside sales? Inbound sales is responding to the enquiries generated from marketing activities, thus they are sales qualified leads with higher probability of conversions. In Inbound sales, the prospect expresses interest and initiates the sales process. The sales people acts as a consultant, addressing the prospects pain points, aligning the sales process to the buyer��s journey. Why should I outsource customer care? With the rapid digital transformation of businesses online post COVID, start-ups and mid-sized businesses can quickly scale up their operations outsourcing the functions of customer care as quick response rates to the customer interactions on webchats, social media, e-mail and support contact numbers helps in better customer experiences and conversions. What are the benefits of deploying marketing and sales tools? The marketing RoI can be maximized with an effective automation of leads flowing in from multiple marketing platforms, which helps in lead scoring, thus segmenting the sales qualified leads for the sales consultant to attend or follow-up for the sales closures. This rapidly increases the sales volume of each consultant. With automation of sales funnel, we also can analyse the RoI of various marketing channels. Inbound marketing drives customers to our platforms (website, social profiles, youtube channels, Google My Business, etc.,) by creating valuable content and experiences tailored to our target audience with an objective of initiating an interaction or offering a solution to their problem or requirement What is the significance of Inside sales? Inbound sales is responding to the enquiries generated from marketing activities, thus they are sales qualified leads with higher probability of conversions. In Inbound sales, the prospect expresses interest and initiates the sales process. The sales people acts as a consultant, addressing the prospects pain points, aligning the sales process to the buyer��s journey. Why should I outsource customer care? With the rapid digital transformation of businesses online post COVID, start-ups and mid-sized businesses can quickly scale up their operations outsourcing the functions of customer care as quick response rates to the customer interactions on webchats, social media, e-mail and support contact numbers helps in better customer experiences and conversions. What are the benefits of deploying marketing and sales tools? The marketing RoI can be maximized with an effective automation of leads flowing in from multiple marketing platforms, which helps in lead scoring, thus segmenting the sales qualified leads for the sales consultant to attend or follow-up for the sales closures. This rapidly increases the sales volume of each consultant. With automation of sales funnel, we also can analyse the RoI of various marketing channels. Inbound marketing drives customers to our platforms (website, social profiles, youtube channels, Google My Business, etc.,) by creating valuable content and experiences tailored to our target audience with an objective of initiating an interaction or offering a solution to their problem or requirement What is the significance of Inside sales? Inbound sales is responding to the enquiries generated from marketing activities, thus they are sales qualified leads with higher probability of conversions. In Inbound sales, the prospect expresses interest and initiates the sales process. The sales people acts as a consultant, addressing the prospects pain points, aligning the sales process to the buyer��s journey. Why should I outsource customer care? With the rapid digital transformation of businesses online post COVID, start-ups and mid-sized businesses can quickly scale up their operations outsourcing the functions of customer care as quick response rates to the customer interactions on webchats, social media, e-mail and support contact numbers helps in better customer experiences and conversions. What are the benefits of deploying marketing and sales tools? The marketing RoI can be maximized with an effective automation of leads flowing in from multiple marketing platforms, which helps in lead scoring, thus segmenting the sales qualified leads for the sales consultant to attend or follow-up for the sales closures. This rapidly increases the sales volume of each consultant. With automation of sales funnel, we also can analyse the RoI of various marketing channels.
